description:
Brand Introduction

Welcome to Julian Bakery! We're committed to creating delicious, healthy foods that cater to various dietary needs. Born in 1990 from a vision to offer healthier alternatives, today we take pride in our 100% gluten-free, non-GMO products made from the finest ingredients. No matter your dietary preference, we believe in making good food accessible to all. At Julian Bakery, taste, health, and quality are harmoniously intertwined.


Product Description

- ProGranola: A delectable and hearty blend of nutrients, our ProGranolas offer a satisfying crunch that's perfect for breakfast or a quick snack. This low-carb, high-fiber, protein-packed granola fuels your day right.

- Protein Bars: Our Protein Bars are perfect on-the-go snacks or meal replacements, loaded with high-quality protein to satisfy your hunger while supporting muscle recovery and growth.

- Protein Powder: Sourced from premium ingredients, our Egg White-based Protein Powders provide an easy way to add a powerful punch of protein to your diet. It's great for shakes, smoothies, or baking, enhancing your meals with essential nutrients.

- Crackers: Our Salt & Pepper Crackers, and Organic Parmesan Crackers are made from wholesome ingredients, offering a gluten-free and low-carb alternative to traditional snack options.

- PureMonk: A zero-calorie, erythritol-free, all-natural sweetener, PureMonk makes it easy to add a touch of sweetness to your favorite beverages and dishes without the sugar crash.

- Bread: Our Bread range is a game-changer for those seeking gluten-free, low-carb options. Enjoy the comforting taste and texture of traditional bread while maintaining your health-conscious lifestyle.

- Coconut Wraps: Flexible and flavorful, these wraps provide a 100% organic solution for every meal. 

- Coconut Flakes: Perfect for adding a tropical twist to your meals, our Coconut Flakes bring crunch and flavor to breakfasts, desserts, and snacks. It's a delightful way to enjoy the health benefits of coconut.


USP (Unique Selling Point)

Julian Bakery's unique selling point lies in its commitment to creating a diverse range of products that cater to a variety of dietary needs, all while not compromising on taste or quality. It's the union of health-conscious and flavorful foods.

Our products are crafted from only the highest quality, carefully sourced ingredients, and designed to cater to gluten-free, low-carb, keto, paleo, and other specialized diets. This attention to detail and dedication to catering to various dietary needs allows us to serve a wide range of customers who might otherwise struggle to find suitable alternatives.

Moreover, our commitment to transparency and integrity means our customers can trust that they are fueling their bodies with clean, nutritious food. This combination of taste, nutrition, and trust is what truly sets Julian Bakery apart.

Terms and Conditions for the Julian Bakery Affiliate Program

Acceptance of Terms

Julian Bakery will track users who have visited these links using cookies that last for 30 days. Only users who make a purchase while the cookie is active will be considered referrals, and only these users will earn an affiliate commission.

Affiliates will receive a 10% commission on the sales amount of referrals. This commission will be based on the subtotal of the order, excluding taxes and shipping costs. To be eligible for a payout, an affiliate's balance must reach a minimum amount of $10.00 USD by the last day of the previous month. Once a payout is processed, the affiliate's balance resets and starts counting toward the next month. If there's no payout on a certain month, the balance can accumulate until the minimum amount is reached. Balances can only accumulate during a calendar year. After the December payout (between the 1st and the 10th of January), all remaining balances are forfeited.

Termination of Agreement

However, Julian Bakery reserves the right to accept or deny any applications for re-entry into the Affiliate Program, regardless of previous participation status. This decision will be made at the sole discretion of Julian Bakery and may be based on factors including, but not limited to, past compliance with program terms, account activity, and alignment with Julian Bakery's brand values and objectives.
